issuing_body: U.S. Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota
title: Couple in Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme Sentenced to 97 Months’ Imprisonment
supports: Mekfira Hussein was sentenced to 57 months on September 8, 2026 after a January 31, 2025 guilty plea.
Abduljabar Hussein was sentenced to 40 months on September 8, 2026 after a February 5, 2025 guilty plea.
The release says the two obtained approximately $8.8 million in federal child-nutrition funds.
important_qualifications: This release documents these two defendants; it does not state a new program-wide ordinal sentencing count.
The $8.8 million figure is not restitution, forfeiture, or recovery.
